description_en: Queries a list of knowledge bases
kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio list-knowledge-bases --workspace-id 478000 --name myName --knowledge-base-id d-nacr000000sxd2 --next-token 10 --max-results 20 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --creator 26800000004103 --knowledge-base-type TEXT --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListKnowledgeBases

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Used to mark the current starting position for reading; leaving it empty means starting from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: When querying using NextToken, the maximum number of results returned each time
parameters.help_zh: 使用 NextToken 方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Sorting field. Currently, only GmtCreateTime is supported
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the queried instances.

*   ASC: ascending order.
*   DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。

- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: Current page number. Value range: greater than 0. Default value: 1. If MaxResults is passed in at the same time, the NextToken query method will be used, and this field value will be ignored
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数。 取值范围：大于0。 默认值：1。如果同时传入MaxResults，则使用NextToken查询方式，忽略此字段值
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of queries per page. If MaxResults is passed in at the same time, the quantity will be based on MaxResults
parameters.help_zh: 每页查询的数量。如果同时传入 MaxResults，则以 MaxResults 数量为准
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the knowledge base.

*   TEXT: Document.
*   STRUCTURED: Structured data.
*   IMAGE: Image.
*   VIDEO: Video
parameters.help_zh:
知识库类型。
- TEXT：文档。
- STRUCTURED：结构化数据。
- IMAGE：图片。
- VIDEO：视频
parameters.name: knowledge_base_type
